author: (Goode & Bean, 1886)

note.en: A grenadier of the deep slope between about 600 and 1400 m; only a regional record.
note.es: Un granadero de la pendiente profunda, entre unos 600 y 1400 m; solo un registro regional.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic, with no local sighting reports found
recWhy: Deep-slope fish with only a FishBase listing for Costa Rica.

marks.en: Deep-water grenadier with a big head and a long tapering tail with two thread-like fin rays.
marks.es: Granadero de aguas profundas con cabeza grande y cola larga y afilada con dos radios filiformes.
